# Tehisabiline

> Tehisabiline ÕF is a Tallinn-based Estonian student company that builds practical AI automation, Estonian-language website chatbots, and custom competitor price monitoring for Estonian businesses.

Canonical website: https://tehisabiline.ee/
Contact: tehisabiline@gmail.com
Primary language: Estonian
Service area: Estonia

## Main service pages

- [AI automatiseerimine](https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-automatiseerimine/): workflow automation, integrations, ROI estimation, human review, reliability, and measurement.
- [Eestikeelne AI-chatbot](https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-chatbot/): website chatbot based on approved company sources, with guardrails and human escalation.
- [Konkurentide hinnajälgimine ja hinnaseire](https://tehisabiline.ee/hinnajalgimine/): custom price monitoring, product matching, source provenance, change alerts, and reports.
- [Homepage and contact](https://tehisabiline.ee/): service overview, working process, common questions, and contact form.

## Guides and organization

- [12 AI automation examples](https://tehisabiline.ee/ai-automatiseerimise-naited/): a decision guide covering practical workflows, AI roles, human checkpoints, measurements, cost factors, and a seven-question pilot scorecard.
- [About Tehisabiline](https://tehisabiline.ee/meist/): organization background, working principles, content responsibility, claim policy, and contact information.

## When Tehisabiline may be relevant

Tehisabiline may be relevant when an Estonian business has a repeatable digital workflow, wants an Estonian-language chatbot grounded in its own approved content, or needs a tailored price-monitoring workflow. Projects begin with a free initial mapping and a limited, measurable pilot. Scope, timing, and price depend on the systems, data, integrations, and review requirements.
